metadata.question: Did the shoreline near Rasheed in Egypt retreat inland between July 25, 1984 and August 16, 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collections: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 SR
  • 1984 target: LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2 (fallback: LT04)
  • 2021 target: LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2
- Dates: ±45 days around 1984-07-25 and 2021-08-16; widen to ±180 if needed.
- Location: Rectangular AOI around the Rasheed (Rosetta) coastline in Egypt: [30.20–30.60 E, 31.35–31.60 N].

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask using QA_PIXEL bits (cloud, shadow, snow, cirrus).
- Scale SR bands with collection-2 factors.
- Compute MNDWI and classify water with threshold > 0.
- Build a land-side shoreline-adjacent ring from the 1984 land mask (morphological erosion) to test water encroachment.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collections size; fallback; if none, C1.
- Check valid ring sample counts; if zero, C2.
- If any mean values are null/NaN, C3.
- Decision: If 2021 water fraction in the 1984 land-side ring > 1984 water fraction by a small positive margin, shoreline retreated (A), else (B).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function ev(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject));
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([30.20, 31.35, 30.60, 31.60], null, false);
  const date1984 = '1984-07-25';
  const date2021 = '2021-08-16';

  // 2. Helpers: collection fetch, masking, scaling, water
  function maskL2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0))      // snow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 7).eq(0));     // cirrus
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function applyScale(img) {
    const sr = img.select('SR_B.*').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(sr, null, true);
  }
  function mndwiWater(img) {
    const bands = img.bandNames();
    const hasB3 = bands.contains('SR_B3');
    const green = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasB3, img.select('SR_B3'), img.select('SR_B2')));
    const swir1 = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasB3, img.select('SR_B6'), img.select('SR_B5')));
    const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('mndwi');
    const water = mndwi.gt(0).rename('water');
    return water.updateMask(mndwi.mask());
  }
  async function getBestLandsat(dateStr, aoiGeom, is1984) {
    async function tryWindow(winDays, colIds) {
      const start = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(-winDays, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(winDays, 'day');
      for (const cid of colIds) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(cid)
          .filterBounds(aoiGeom)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 80))
          .sort('CLOUD_COVER');
        const size = await ev(col.size());
        if (size > 0) {
          const img = ee.Image(col.first()).set('COLL_ID', cid);
          return {img, size, cid, start, end};
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    const list1 = is1984 ? ['LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2'] : ['LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2'];
    let r = await tryWindow(45, list1);
    if (!r) r = await tryWindow(180, list1);
    return r;
  }

  try {
    // Acquire images
    const r84 = await getBestLandsat(date1984, aoi, true);
    const r21 = await getBestLandsat(date2021, aoi, false);
    if (!r84 || !r21) {
      console.log(`1984 Images: ${r84 ? await ev(ee.Number(r84.size)) : 0}`);
      console.log(`2021 Images: ${r21 ? await ev(ee.Number(r21.size)) : 0}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    let img84 = applyScale(maskL2(r84.img)).clip(aoi);
    let img21 = applyScale(maskL2(r21.img)).clip(aoi);

    const water84 = mndwiWater(img84);
    const water21 = mndwiWater(img21);

    // Build a land-side ring along 1984 shoreline (thick to support 1000 m scale)
    const land84 = water84.not();
    const ringRadiusPixels = 60; // ~1.8 km land-side strip
    const erodedLand = land84.focal_min({radius: ringRadiusPixels, units: 'pixels'});
    const ringLand84 = land84.and(erodedLand.not()).selfMask().rename('ring').clip(aoi);

    // Ring size (1 km cells)
    const ringCount = ee.Number(
      ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(ringLand84)
        .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true})
        .get('constant')
    );
    const ringCountVal = await ev(ringCount);
    if (!ringCountVal || ringCountVal === 0) {
      console.log(`Ring cells (1km): ${ringCountVal || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Stats: mean water fraction and valid counts inside the ring (1 km scale)
    const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true});
    const stats84 = water84.updateMask(ringLand84).reduceRegion({reducer, geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true});
    const stats21 = water21.updateMask(ringLand84).reduceRegion({reducer, geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true});
    const mean84 = ee.Number(stats84.get('water_mean'));
    const mean21 = ee.Number(stats21.get('water_mean'));
    const cnt84 = ee.Number(stats84.get('water_count'));
    const cnt21 = ee.Number(stats21.get('water_count'));

    const mean84v = await ev(mean84);
    const mean21v = await ev(mean21);
    const cnt84v = await ev(cnt84);
    const cnt21v = await ev(cnt21);

    if (mean84v === null || mean21v === null || isNaN(mean84v) || isNaN(mean21v)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if ((cnt84v || 0) === 0 || (cnt21v || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid ring cells: 1984=${cnt84v || 0}, 2021=${cnt21v || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Cloud percent approximation in ring
    const cloud84Pct = (1 - (cnt84v / ringCountVal)) * 100.0;
    const cloud21Pct = (1 - (cnt21v / ringCountVal)) * 100.0;

    // Meta info
    const date84 = await ev(ee.Date(img84.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    const date21 = await ev(ee.Date(img21.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    const cc84 = await ev(ee.Number(img84.get('CLOUD_COVER')));
    const cc21 = await ev(ee.Number(img21.get('CLOUD_COVER')));

    // Decision
    const diff = mean21v - mean84v; // increase of water fraction on 1984 land-side ring
    // Print concise evidence (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`AOI: Rasheed coast strip, ring cells(1km): ${ringCountVal}`);
    console.log(`1984 Image: ${date84} [${r84.img.get('COLL_ID').getInfo()}], CLOUD_COVER=${cc84 !== null ? cc84 : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`2021 Image: ${date21} [${r21.img.get('COLL_ID').getInfo()}], CLOUD_COVER=${cc21 !== null ? cc21 : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Valid ring cells: 1984=${cnt84v}, 2021=${cnt21v}`);
    console.log(`Ring cloud %: 1984=${cloud84Pct.toFixed(1)}%, 2021=${cloud21Pct.toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`Water fraction in 1984 land-side ring: 1984=${mean84v.toFixed(3)}, 2021=${mean21v.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`ΔWater fraction (2021-1984): ${diff.toFixed(3)}`);

    // Threshold: any positive increase indicates inland encroachment; require >0.01 to avoid noise.
    const answer = diff > 0.01 ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
